failure_patterns.pattern: cache_persistence_omission_or_invalid_payload: Searches and filters were often not saved, or were saved as a results list instead of the complete tool result.

rejected_edits.content: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated. When a user answers a domain-specific follow-up question, treat the reply as an update to that pending domain and include all explicit, schema-supported criteria in the reply, not just the one asked about. Apply only new criteria to the compatible cached base and save the updated result. Assistant-suggested values are not user-provided unless explicitly confirmed.
rejected_edits.target: - Resolve brief affirmations such as “yes” against the immediately preceding assistant question or proposal, and carry forward the proposed entity or category as stated.

rejected_edits.content: - If a later reply supplies missing required inputs for a previously requested but not-yet-searched domain, perform that pending search in the same turn; do not rerun or transform domains whose criteria are unchanged. For a restaurant request tied to a trip, use the trip's stated destination as its city unless the user specifies another city. Continue only independent requested domains whose own required inputs are complete; do not ask again for known values or optional hotel occupancy or room details.
rejected_edits.target: Still perform every independent requested search or update whose own required inputs are complete in the same turn.
